enforce-lease.mechanism: recipe instruction block only: Goose has no per-path write gate (no PreToolUse hook, no project-scoped permission). The lease/write-scope is stated as an instruction the model is asked to honor; it is NOT blocked. LOUD DEGRADATION: native enforced lease -> advisory.

block-dangerous.mechanism: generated Goose permission policy (permission.yaml user section: shell/Bash tool -> never_allow for the dangerous set, ask_before otherwise) delivered via an ephemeral XDG_CONFIG_HOME config dir (the launcher copies it + the user's config.yaml into a throwaway dir; ~/.config/goose is never mutated) + GOOSE_MODE=smart_approve LLM PermissionJudge. Approximation, not the deterministic regex blocker: a permission decision, not a hard PreToolUse exit. DEGRADATION: native -> adapted.

protect-sensitive.mechanism: generated Goose permission policy (Read/Write/Edit -> ask_before; sensitive paths -> never_allow where expressible) delivered via an ephemeral XDG_CONFIG_HOME config dir (the launcher copies it + the user's config.yaml into a throwaway dir; ~/.config/goose is never mutated) + smart_approve PermissionJudge. Goose permissions cannot path-scope as precisely as the sensitive-file-protector; coverage is approximate. DEGRADATION: native -> adapted.

format.mechanism: recipe instruction block only: Goose has no PostToolUse hook, so post-edit formatting cannot be enforced. The recipe instructs the agent to format edited files. DEGRADATION: native -> advisory.

typecheck.mechanism: recipe instruction block only: Goose has no PostToolUse hook, so post-edit type-checking cannot be enforced. The recipe instructs the agent to type-check edited files. DEGRADATION: native -> advisory.

budget.mechanism: recipe instruction block only: Goose has no SubagentStop hook, so change-budget reporting cannot be enforced. The recipe instructs the agent to report its change budget. DEGRADATION: native -> advisory.
